Do you why voting in local elections matter if you support #BLM?

Mayors hire the Chief of Police.
The Chief of Police sets the policies and training of the Police.
Directly impacts BLM

So Vote in every local election.

We need to be like a hum.  A crescendo of sound. It doesn't have to be homogenous.  It can have different themes. #neveragain #BLM #resist 

But it shouldn't stop and it shouldn't falter.  

Don't give them anything to grab on to.  

We need to be like a snowball rolling downhill

Police are hired by police chief.
Police chief is hired by Mayor.
Mayor & Police chief is influenced by who turns out to vote.

#BLM & it matters that you turn out to vote in November.

If you don't believe it, ask yourself why do GOP go to such lengths to suppress the vote?
